raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Torch-profiler trace of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DEP2 prefill on GB300 (MegaAttention, MegaMoE, DSpark, 16K-token prefill budget per rank), one 16K-token cold chunk per rank, rank 0:

| Dense MXFP8 GEMM (`flashinfer_mm_mxfp8` → CuTe-DSL `dense_blockscaled_gemm_sm100`) | |
|---|---:|
| Launches per step | 210 (130 after #44837 removes the shared-expert MLP) |
| Per launch | 221 µs |
| Total per step | 46.5 ms of a 322 ms step |
| Shapes at M=16,384 | fused wqkv_a N=1792 K=5120; wq_b N=32768 K=1280; wo_b N=5120 K=8192 |

Every one of these launches runs on FlashInfer's untuned fallback tactic: the server log has no autotune pass at all, and `Fp8LinearMethod.apply` keeps `pin_tactic=True` for block-FP8-as-MXFP8 layers until the prefill autotune hook sets `mxfp8_prefill_autotune_min_tokens`, which never happens.

## Why

`should_run_flashinfer_autotune` treats FP8 dense GEMMs as tunable only for `quantization == "mxfp8"` (and modelopt per-tensor FP8). DeepSeek-V4.1 checkpoints are block-FP8 `[32, 32]` with `ue8m0` scales, which `Fp8LinearMethod` serves through the MXFP8 view on FlashInfer CuTe-DSL, the same tunable `mm_mxfp8` op. The model already has `autotune_prefill_kernels` / `wants_prefill_autotune` (from #38798) to tune exactly those GEMMs at the prefill token ceiling, but it is only reached from the gated autotune pass, so it never ran.

## Modifications

- `should_run_flashinfer_autotune`: also return True when a resident FP8 linear serves block-FP8 as MXFP8 on a FlashInfer CuTe-DSL/CUTLASS backend (`_model_serves_block_fp8_as_mxfp8_on_flashinfer`). The existing decode-shaped pass and the DeepSeek-V4.1 prefill hook then run and persist tactics under `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR/flashinfer/autotune/...` exactly as for `mxfp8` models, so restarts stay fast.
- Drops the stale "SGLang temporarily skips mxfp8_gemm by default due to an IMA" help text on `--flashinfer-autotune-skip-ops`; `FLASHINFER_AUTOTUNE_WORKAROUND_SKIPS` has been empty since #33962.
- Numerics: tuned tactics change only the GEMM tile/cluster schedule. Batch-invariant and deterministic modes keep the pinned tactic as before (`pin_tactic` override in `Fp8LinearMethod.apply` is unchanged).

## Measured

GB300, DEP2 (TP2 + DP attention, EP2), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MegaMoE, Mega-mHC, decoder bounded replay, eager prefill, 16K-token prefill budget per rank, rank 0. Main (job 3470, `2d3dd3168d`) against this branch (job 3471). Startup log on the branch, both ranks: `Running FlashInfer autotune with cache: .../flashinfer/autotune/0.7.1/sm103/.../rank_tp0_pp0_dp0.json`.

| Unprofiled, median of 3 | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| One 16K-token cold chunk per rank (ms) | 247 | 235 |
| 128K-token prompt in eight 16K chunks (ms) | 1,906 | 1,773 |
| 8 x 2K fresh tokens on 90K cached tokens per rank (ms) | 672 | 669 |

| Profiled 16K step | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| Dense MXFP8 GEMM launches per step | 212 | 212 |
| Dense MXFP8 GEMM time per step (ms) | 46.5 | 29.9 |
| Mean per launch (µs) | 220 | 141 |
| Layer 6, fused wqkv_a / wq_b / wo_b GEMM (µs) | 160 / 563 / 721 | 88 / 449 / 369 |
| Attention section, layer 6 (ms) | 5.00 | 4.48 |

The step is dispatch-bound, so most of the 16.6 ms of removed GEMM time hides behind launch gaps on a single chunk; it shows fully on the 128K prompt.

Before: main, layer 6, 5.00 ms between the two mHC kernels.

![main, layer 6 attention section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kpham-sgl/sglang/assets-prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/main-job3470-layer6-attention-section.jpg)

After: this branch, same layer, 4.48 ms; the three dense GEMMs are the shorter purple slices.

![this PR, layer 6 attention section](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kpham-sgl/sglang/assets-prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/prefill-h2h-2026-10-16/pr44842-job3471-layer6-attention-section.jpg)

detail.title: [Perf] deepseek_v4: run FlashInfer autotune for block-FP8 models served as MXFP8

files.patch:
@@ -359,8 +359,7 @@ class ExecKernel(msgspec.Struct):
         Arg(
             help=(
                 "FlashInfer custom-op identifiers to skip during autotuning. "
-                "Skipped ops use FlashInfer's heuristic fallback. SGLang "
-                "temporarily skips mxfp8_gemm by default due to an IMA."
+                "Skipped ops use FlashInfer's heuristic fallback."
             ),
             nargs="+",
         ),

@@ -56,6 +56,24 @@ def get_flashinfer_autotune_skip_ops(model_runner: ModelRunner) -> set[str]:
     return skip_ops
 
 
+def _serves_block_fp8_as_mxfp8_on_flashinfer(model_runner: ModelRunner) -> bool:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8LinearMethod
+
+    for module in model_runner.model.modules():
+        method = getattr(module, "quant_method", None)
+        if (
+            isinstance(method, Fp8LinearMethod)
+            and method.block_fp8_as_mxfp8
+            and module.block_fp8_mxfp8_ready
+            and (
+                method.mxfp8_dense_backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl()
+                or method.mxfp8_dense_backend.is_flashinfer_cutlass()
+            )
+        ):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
 def should_run_flashinfer_autotune(
     model_runner: ModelRunner, *, for_speculative_draft: bool = False
 ) -> bool:
@@ -124,7 +142,7 @@ def should_run_flashinfer_autotune(
     elif model_quantization in ("modelopt", "modelopt_fp8", "modelopt_mixed"):
         fp8_gemm_needs_autotune = flashinfer_per_tensor_fp8_supported()
     else:
-        fp8_gemm_needs_autotune = False
+        fp8_gemm_needs_autotune = _serves_block_fp8_as_mxfp8_on_flashinfer(mr)
 
     if not (moe_needs_autotune or fp4_gemm_needs_autotune or fp8_gemm_needs_autotune):
         return False
